summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared generator venv. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in that venv, so type-checking and lint were checked only by reading the code. I added a separate non-node input test beyond the single parametrized test the spec asks for, and I did not put a type-ignore on the pytest.raises line. Nothing was committed, and no existing file was modified.
